target_gap.service: Workbench notebook/files and referenced startup code
target_gap.retained_gap: Notebook files, cached VM script and original execution are unsupported; only selected current referenced GCS source association is demonstrated offline.

change_scope: NEW files only; no shared engine, collector, registry, canonical review, UI, tracking, IAM or infrastructure changes

native_binding.identity: Exact returned name and required unique Instance.id; actual createTime and gceSetup.instanceId are validated and bound when returned.
native_binding.relationship: Exact selected gceSetup.metadata key equals selected gs://bucket/object on both reads.
native_binding.behavior: Post-startup behavior and presence are bound before/after; absent uses documented run_once default; conflicting/invalid/changed behavior is UNKNOWN.
native_binding.project_owner: Explicit owned selected project scope resolved by native projectId and numeric name; native bucket projectNumber must equal it on both reads.
native_binding.generation: Unpinned latest metadata before and after must match selected generation and metadata; media read uses generation and ifGenerationMatch, exact native generation header/size/type/framing.
native_binding.systemMetadata: Schema exists, but no key-specific standalone membership guarantee found in primary docs; corroboration/conflict evidence only, unsupported selector, no synthetic positive fixture.
native_binding.limits: Point-in-time read bracket, no transaction or change-and-revert proof; no cached VM or executed byte proof.

unsupported.legacy: v1 top-level postStartupScript/runtime/instance forms are excluded; current retirement notice describes March 30, 2026 deletion of managed notebooks and conversion of user-managed notebooks to ordinary Compute VMs.
unsupported.missing_identity_or_reference: UNKNOWN; never substitute name, timestamp, selector or selected GCS copy for native relationship

privacy.redaction: Shared ephemeral HMAC union, snapshot/options/cache/evidence/collector scrubbing; raw selections removed; state cleared in finally.
privacy.diagnostics: HTTP/HTTPS/urllib3 wire debugging and effective DEBUG connection-pool logging refused before credentials.
privacy.executed_commands: No source execution or filesystem access; unchanged local pinned detector subprocess contract only.

low_level_reuse.native_receipts: Genuine reviewed project/GCS reader receipts retain dataproc-source-read IDs; only actual new v2 instance GETs issue workbench-source-read IDs; no fabricated receipts or parent collections.

native_evidence.provenance: Offline fake native HTTP -> actual bounded producer -> sealed snapshot -> pure consumer; no cloud/auth performed.
matrix: Both supported selected fields and both real detector clean/positive results
Missing/changed native ID, creation time and VM ID
Missing key, legacy top-level and system-only reference
Latest generation before/after and media binding
Default-off, exact named admission and 1-4 selection bounds
Call limit, deadline, cancellation and principal changes
Shared HMAC cross-reader dedup and final union privacy scrubbing

remaining: No production registration/integration requested or performed; no live cloud behavior or notebook-wide secret scan certified.
